unresolved.observation: Both bundles and vPCs report up, but client to secondary orphan is 0/5 with one peer-link member shut, including after 95 seconds, after Nexus-originated probes pass, and without peer-switch. The final 40-second restoration wait still left this flow failing. An earlier settled full restoration passed all five paths.
unresolved.packetTrace: Echo requests and replies are present on the secondary orphan link. In failing probes, replies return across the surviving peer-link, and no matching reply is observed on either access uplink or client link. In the successful recovery probe, replies instead leave the secondary access uplink and reach the client. This locates the native return-path discrepancy but does not establish its root cause.
unresolved.modelContract: Continue forwarding over the remaining peer-link member; do not encode this unexplained reference failure as desired NX-OS behavior.
